title: What We Still Have to Solve

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The later account of a corrigible civilization connects technical power with institutional capacity to learn.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Its detailed comparisons show why climate, health, security, and AI cannot remain isolated conversations.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The book asks what new dependencies accompany an intervention that looks successful on its own.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Read it to examine the whole system a proposed solution will actually enter.
